name: Bhagavad Gita 12.10
text:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव ।
मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि ॥
meaning: If you cannot practise meditation, dedicate yourself to my work. Even acting for my sake, you will reach perfection.
purpose: If formal meditation is difficult, dedicate meaningful action.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
